title: ProbeID: Verifying MCP Tool Identity for LLM Agents under Registry Drift
abstract: arXiv:2610.33633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agents select tools by copyable descriptions, which cannot establish which implementation runs. ProbeID compares canonicalized responses to schema-valid probes with a trusted admission reference and abstains on ambiguity, so a squatter must copy probe-observable behavior. With the gold present, independent probes and a fixed margin, standard concentration arguments give a shared probe budget logarithmic in the candidate count and bound the joint probability of a wrong decision. On cached MCP-IdentityDrift cases, strict choice reaches \(0.956\) hit@1 while description routers fall near chance, but simpler exact comparisons tie it, MMD better tolerates heavy value noise, and a 32B behavioral judge is similarly accurate at higher cost. Random probes from agent banks and a prospective held-out study of 38 tools test theory-set thresholds. translated_title: ProbeID：在注册表漂移下为LLM智能体验证MCP工具身份
translated_abstract: 智能体通过可复制的描述来选择工具，但这无法确定实际运行的是哪个实现。ProbeID 将针对模式合法探测（schema-valid probes）的规范化响应与可信的准入参考进行比较，并在存在歧义时弃权，从而使抢注者必须复制可被探测观察到的行为。在存在黄金工具（gold）的情况下，基于独立探测和固定裕度，标准集中性论证给出了随候选数量呈对数增长的共享探测预算，并界定了错误决策的联合概率。在缓存的 MCP-IdentityDrift 案例上，严格选择达到 0.956 的 hit@1，而基于描述的路由器接近随机水平；但更简单的精确比较可达到相同效果，MMD 能更好地容忍严重的值噪声，而 32B 行为判定器以更高成本达到相近的准确率。来自智能体库的随机探测以及对 38 个工具的前瞻性留存研究用于检验理论设定的阈值。在智能体库上，等值判断仅通过 64 次探测即拒绝了每一个可达的替换，并且有界距离（摘要至此截断）……
tldr: 提出ProbeID方法，通过将模式合法探测的规范化响应与可信参考进行比较来验证MCP工具身份，防御注册表漂移下的工具抢注攻击，并以对数级探测预算实现有理论保证的错误概率上界。
en_tdlr: ProbeID verifies MCP tool identity for LLM agents under registry drift by comparing canonicalized responses to schema-valid probes against a trusted reference, achieving a logarithmic probe budget with theoretically bounded error probability against tool squatters.
